plugins.name: thinking-tools
plugins.description: Claude Code thinking-tools plugin: 8 skills for structured reasoning, debate, document polish, blind-spot detection, and idea crystallization, plus a thinking-facilitator agent.

plugins.name: obsidian-vault-manager
plugins.description: Obsidian vault knowledge management plugin (v4): capture / note / audit / base skills + 2 agents for a minimal second-brain workflow. audit detects E1–E11 structural defects (incl. E9 tag/property vocabulary) and promotion candidates. base generates non-destructive Obsidian Bases (.base) views. type-optin; ovm-primitives shell API.

plugins.name: vault-bridge
plugins.description: Obsidian vault ↔ project bridge for Claude Code: manifest cache, read-only vault-searcher agent (haiku), Stop/SessionEnd/SessionStart/PreToolUse hooks, and slash commands (/save-session, /vault-link, /vault-commit, /save-plan-doc, /handoff, /vault-manifest-refresh) with .vault-link project binding and write-role contract.

plugins.name: workflow-harness
plugins.description: claude-kit layer ⑤ execution harness (thin scaffold): a lightweight orchestration plugin on Claude Code native primitives (/goal, Workflow, agents, hooks). One-way dependency (CON-5) harness → leaf plugins (vault-bridge / obsidian-vault-manager), plus a read of the project-local telemetry dogfooding output; reverse imports forbidden. v0.1.0 is a minimal shell — retro and further slice-loop skills land incrementally.
